stem:
What fraction of the circle is shaded?

[Image: A circle divided into two sectors, one shaded and one unshaded]
figure_description: A circle with a center dot. Two radii divide the circle into two sectors. One radius extends straight up from the center to the 12 o'clock position. The other radius extends to the left, slightly below the horizontal 9 o'clock position. The larger sector, which runs clockwise from the top radius around through the right side and bottom to the lower-left radius, is shaded solid gray. The smaller remaining sector in the upper-left area is white (unshaded).
